purpose: Preserve the fail-closed Campaign064 aggregate-manifest rejection and authorize only the dynamic manifest-template adapter correction needed to describe the already frozen high/low-only, zero-lookback computation truthfully.

root_cause.detail: Campaign057-to-Campaign064 outer substitutions transform the inherited aggregate manifest fragment before the Campaign064 inner adapter executes. The inner adapter searched for the earlier false/amount=true fragment, matched zero times, and left inherited close-read and one-session-lookback labels in the in-memory manifest. The high/low source projection, exact 240-bar grid, candidate formula, output partitions, and checkpoint hashes use Campaign064 semantics independently of these labels.

exact_runner_changes: Change only the inner source adapter search fragment from the pre-outer-substitution false/amount=true form to the actually generated source_open_high_low_close_volume_read=true, source_close_read=true, source_amount_read=false, cross_session_lookback=1 form.

Retain the already frozen replacement fragment that emits source_open_high_low_close_volume_read=true, source_high_low_read=true, source_close_read=false, source_amount_read=false, and cross_session_lookback=0.
Point DEFAULT_IMPLEMENTATION_FREEZE to the additive v2 implementation freeze that will bind this repair; do not rewrite v1.
authorized_repair.exact_test_change: Add one synthetic regression assertion that the generated publication template contains the truthful high/low-only and zero-lookback fragment before any snapshot retry.
authorized_repair.resume_rule: Revalidate and reuse every existing hash-bound unpublished checkpoint; recompute no symbol group unless its checkpoint fails the frozen byte/frame/hash checks.

next_action: Apply only the authorized adapter and regression-test changes, freeze implementation v2, rerun focused tests and binding validation, then retry atomic snapshot publication using checkpoint validation.
